changelog: Click Install. A one-time error message will pop up after updating from v1.0.2 — v1.0.3 permanently resolves this for future updates. Simply open the app normally afterward.
downloader_changelog: Single-file forum drop. Unpacks WebView2 helpers into LocalAppData on first run. Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Reads app_manifest.json and downloads the Translator tag listed there (currently translator-v1.0.3).
